title: App memory usage (memoryUsage)
description: memoryUsage() from @silkui/core: the app's memory in bytes as the system shows it to users (Activity Monitor, footprint, Task Manager), to show or compare with other apps.

title: Presented frame stats (frameStats)
description: frameStats() from @silkui/core: frames the window presented, presents per second, painted frames the GPU never drew, and frame time percentiles, which requestAnimationFrame cannot measure.
